data.exact_reserve_text: During 2015 the Syndicate released GBP 95.7m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2014: GBP 77.4m), arising predominantly from the Energy, Casualty and Treaty Divisions (2014: primarily from the Marine, Property and Treaty Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on attritional losses during 2015.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross release of GBP 95.7m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods during 2015 (compared with GBP 77.4m in 2014). The releases were driven predominantly by favourable claims development on attritional losses, mainly in the Energy, Casualty and Treaty divisions. There are no quantified line-by-line reserve movements in the notes; the claim development triangle and the movement note both indicate overall favourable prior-year development.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet liabilities (Claims outstanding, 2014 comparative). Prior year movement comes from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note which explicitly states a GBP 95.7m release (assumed gross). The claims development triangle (gross) was used as a cross-check. Line-by-line reserve movements are not quantified in the notes; named event impacts are described qualitatively and not quantified. 'Reinsurance acceptances' entry is the consolidated reinsurance premium total from the segmental analysis as the table separates direct insurance and reinsurance.
